newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Cahaya says in 62 bln rph acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Cahaya says in 62 bln rph acquisition.

text.p: Indonesian cocoa processor and edible oil producer PT Cahaya Kalbar said on Friday that it intended to acquire a privately-owned firm at an estimated cost of 62 billion rupiah.
"The management of Cahaya Kalbar has informed the Stock Exchange Supervisory Agency (Bapepam) about the intention to acquire the assets and business of PT Mintawi," the company said in a statement.
It said details will be finalised at the company's next shareholders meeting on June 20, 1997.
The statement said that the targeted firm was involved in manufacturing and trading coconut oil, palm kernel oil, cooking oil and other oils.

"The acquisition will enhance profitability and long-term growth prospects of the firm. Meanwhile, the management is confident of achieving a net profit of 28 and 42 billion rupiah respectively for 1997 and 1998," Cahaya said.
